name: Washington Square, San Francisco
description: A 360 × 360 metre interpretation of North Beach, traced from 2024 NAIP and audited against official park, art and street records. Structured facts distinguish sourced measurements, observations, estimates and unknowns. The 2022 NOAA reference offers finer detail at an older date. This is a spatial sketch, not a measured survey.

origin.note: Southwest corner. x east, y north. Scaled Web Mercator local frame (cos 37.8008°); reference image 1200 × 1200 px at 0.3 local m/px. See public/reference/washington-square-georeference.json.

sources.title: NOAA orthophoto · August 2022 · 25 cm
sources.attribution: NOAA National Geodetic Survey / Office for Coastal Management. CC0-1.0.
sources.notes: Acquired 4–7 August 2022; nominal 0.25 m GSD. Higher detail but older than the 2024 NAIP reference. Metadata explicitly dedicates imagery to CC0.

sources.title: SF Planning aerial viewer · 8 cm layers
sources.attribution: City and County of San Francisco, Planning Department
sources.notes: External inspection link. Includes p2024_rgb8cm and p2025_rgb8cm. Dataset-specific redistribution rights were not established from official metadata, so city tiles are not bundled.

sources.title: Washington Square · 2017 tree assessment / 2018 plans
sources.attribution: SF Planning / SF Recreation and Parks / HortScience
sources.notes: Pages 45–46, 58 and 65 identify central Lombardy poplars and provide a schematic tree map. Pages 2–5 describe wood benches with CMU legs and perimeter improvements. Historical inventory, not proof of every present tree.

sources.title: SF Public Works street tree inventory
sources.attribution: San Francisco Public Works; Open Data Commons PDDL
sources.notes: 668 Filbert records 142751–142754 locate four London planes. Positions imported; no DBH used as crown diameter. Extract saved in public/reference.

sources.title: SF streets · active centerlines and direction
sources.attribution: City and County of San Francisco; Open Data Commons PDDL
sources.notes: Active crop-intersecting segments: B means traffic legal both directions. Powell contains B/F/T segments, so no single direction is assigned to its aggregate road object.

sources.title: SFMTA speed limits per street segment
sources.notes: Columbus 20 mph; Union/Stockton/Green have 20 mph sections. Preserve segment scope. Zero is a default-data code, not a 0 mph restriction. Filbert school-zone record is 15 mph and dated 2018. These are reference attributes, not live driving advice.

sources.title: Benjamin Franklin · city art collection
sources.notes: Catalog reports installed dimensions of 204 × 40 × 40 in, sculpture 66 in tall, base 138 in tall; pot metal on concrete. Photos remain external.

sources.title: Sacred Space International · church architecture
sources.notes: Pages 5–7: Charles Fantoni; Gothic Revival with Romanesque details; steel and reinforced concrete; school on fifth level; nave interior 60 ft high. Interior clearance is not roof height.

sources.title: Washington Square · city landmark history
sources.notes: Park history and context, including Franklin statue relocation 1904, predominance of three-story buildings on park perimeter and surviving historic landscape.

sources.title: Washington Square · map and street-level reference
sources.attribution: Google Maps; imagery attribution shown by the provider
sources.notes: External inspection only. Used qualitatively for visible benches and monument comparison; no Google imagery is redistributed.

sources.title: USDA NAIP aerial · 20 May 2024
sources.attribution: USDA Farm Production and Conservation, National Agriculture Imagery Program. Public-domain U.S. government imagery.
sources.notes: Raster m_3712213_se_10_060_20240520 (OBJECTID 11934), 0.6 m source. Downloaded north-up as 1200 px JPEG, 0.3 local m/px (resampled, not additional detail). Local reference: /reference/washington-square-naip.jpg. Geometry hand-traced; no OSM data used.

sources.title: Saints Peter and Paul · parish history
sources.notes: Reports 100 × 160 ft church dimensions and 191 ft twin spires. Tower bases and nave mass remain approximate.

sources.title: Washington Square · San Francisco Recreation and Parks
sources.notes: Confirms park identity, lawn setting, Filbert/Stockton address, and 3.17 acre area. Scene includes surrounding blocks.
